name: Treats for Great-father Winter
summary: At the Smokywood Pastures display in Orgrimmar, the Greatfather Winter performer is worn out from hearing holiday wishes. He asks you for gingerbread cookies and milk.

sections.title: A Weary Patron of Winter
sections.body: The Greatfather Winter who greets visitors in the Valley of Strength works for Smokywood Pastures. Long hours listening to citizens speak of festive treats leave him hungry. He turns to passing travelers for warm baking and a cold drink.

sections.title: Culinary Holiday Spirit
sections.body: You can bake the cookies with Holiday Spices sold by Smokywood Pastures peddlers and Small Eggs gathered from wild birds. Bring them together with Ice Cold Milk from a local tavern, and the feast's organizers offer you festive cheer and a small token of gratitude.

faq.q: Who is Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar?
aliases: is he the real winter father
faq.answer: In Orgrimmar, Greatfather Winter is an actor hired by Smokywood Pastures to portray the legendary figure during the Feast of Winter Veil. He sits near the holiday trade display in the Valley of Strength, greeting Horde citizens and listening to their festive requests.

faq.q: What treats does Greatfather Winter ask for?
faq.answer: He asks you for five Gingerbread Cookies and one serving of Ice Cold Milk to help him through a long day of greeting holiday visitors.

faq.q: How do you make Gingerbread Cookies?
faq.answer: Smokywood Pastures vendors around the holiday display sell the recipe and Holiday Spices. Combine the spices with Small Eggs gathered from wild birds, then bake the cookies over a cooking fire.

faq.q: Where can Ice Cold Milk be found?
aliases: where to get ice cold milk
faq.answer: You can buy Ice Cold Milk from food and drink vendors, innkeepers, or barkeeps throughout Orgrimmar and other major settlements.

faq.q: Why is Greatfather Winter asking for food himself?
faq.answer: Listening to children and citizens talk about food, gifts, and festivities all day leaves the Greatfather Winter performer hungry. Since he cannot easily leave his post in the Valley of Strength, he asks passing travelers for a quick snack.

faq.q: Does this quest have an Alliance counterpart?
faq.answer: Yes. In Ironforge, Greatfather Winter makes the same request of Alliance champions for gingerbread cookies and cold milk during the festival.

angles.text: As an apprentice chef, you can practice simple baking by turning wild eggs and seasonal spices into festive gingerbread.
In Orgrimmar, Smokywood Pastures' goblin traders bring the feast and a moment of domestic cheer to the warrior city.
